d.s: Sika Stabilizer-4 R AU is a ready to use liquid-based viscosity modifying admixture. Sika Stabilizer-4 R AU improves stability and segregation resistance of concrete mixes without significant reduction of slump or flow, resulting in improved surface quality and aesthetics. Sika Stabilizer-4 R AU is suitable for various types of concrete. Sika Stabilizer-4 R AU has been found to improve plastic properties of Self Consolidating Concrete (SCC) as well as high slump conventional concrete mixes, and mixes containing manufactured sand and/or poorly graded aggregates. Sika Stabilizer-4 R AU helps stabilize the air void system in freshly mixed and placed concrete and increases the overall concrete stability. Sika Stabilizer-4 R AU is compatible with Sika ViscoCrete high range water reducing admixtures and is recommended for precast and ready mix concrete applications.
a: Enhances stability of concrete matrix integrity during high slump placements
Increases the cohesiveness of lean and harsh mix designs
us: Sika Stabilizer-4 R AU is suitable for usage in cases when:
Improved flow & aesthetics of low slump extruded concrete mixes
Higher resistance to segregation is required
Improved stability during transportation is required
Manufactured sand and/or “gap-graded” coarse aggregate is used
Migration of air within the concrete mixture is observed
Fluctuation of water content in aggregates causes inconsistent production
d.pk: Sika Stabilizer-4 R AU is available in 1000 litres IBC, 10 litres container and bulk deliveries.

sec.t: Sika Stabilizer-4 R AU meets the requirements of Australian Standard 1478.1-2000 for type SN (special-purpose normal setting) admixture for concrete.
Shelf life when stored in dry warehouse conditions between 5 °C and 35 °C is six months.
Sika Stabilizer-4 R AU should be stored above 5 °C . Protect from frost and direct sunlight.If frozen, thaw and agitate thoroughly to return to normal state.

Sika Stabilizer-4 R AU should be added to the fresh concrete after all other mix ingredients have been blended together. Addition of the Sika Stabilizer-4 R AU directly into the concrete too early may promote clumping of the mix materials. Sika Stabilizer-4 R AU may also be dispensed into freshly mixed concrete in a ready mix truck at the concrete plant or at the job site. When added on site, mixer should rotate its drum at maximum speed for a minimum of 2 minutes/m3. Sika Stabilizer-4 R AU should on no account be added to a dry mix.
Sika Stabilizer-4 R AU can be used in conjunction with most of the Sika Concrete products, except Sika VMA . Trials are always recommended before use.

Dosage rates will vary according to materials used, ambient conditions and the requirements of a specific project. Sika recommends dosage at 200–1500 ml/100 kg of cementitious materials. Dosage rates outside the recommended range may be used where extreme ambient conditions are encountered or unusual project conditions require special consideration. In this case please contact your local Sales Representative .
